title: Hashi Bridges
tagline: Join the islands. Pure logic, hints that teach.
description: The island-and-bridge logic puzzle on a calm lagoon. Every puzzle has exactly one solution and is graded by the techniques a person needs. Daily puzzle, undo, and hints that explain the logic step by step. Portrait or landscape, phone or tablet.
howToPlay: Join the islands with bridges so each island has exactly its number.
Tap an island, then a neighbour in line. Tap again for a double bridge.
Bridges never cross, and every island must end up connected.
Tap the bulb for a hint: where to look, then why it works.
Watch and Learn solves a puzzle for you and explains every step.
